message: ロロット沼編
Since it was the day before the event, students and participants were all mixed together preparing, and the place was gradually getting livelier.

name: Synn
message: 「That about does it for the setup, I guess.」
As for me, I'd finished up the heavy lifting and was taking a break, drinking the tea Ria-senpai had brewed for me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Preside~~nt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte. How's it going?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, everything is going very smoothly. How are things on your end?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just finished up right now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, would you mind helping me out from here on~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, sounds good. So, what are we doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The single most important thing a food stall has to be careful about. Do you know what it is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whether they're making good, cheap food properly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bzzzt. It's hygiene. We are going to put our own bodies on the line to verify whether each stall's food is safe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Put our bodies on the line--you mean you and me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ What you'd call guinea pigs. So, let's go around doing taste tests together right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Taste tests... wait, does that mean all-you-can-eat for free!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is indeed the case♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoooa, long live the Student Council Preside~nt.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's get going right away.\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The okonomiyaki stall. Double circle--full marks.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hey. You've got sauce on your face.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmh... *lick*」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not very proper for a young lady~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Keep it a secret from Jiiya, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, everywhere you look...」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really is. I feel like I could keep eating forever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mhm, mhm!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, the next shop is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome, thanks for coming!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're here for the Yuugiri-an tasting~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please give us a massive, extra-large serving.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Coming right up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This gets a gold star! Thank you for the meal~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hope it was to your liking. And with that, switching out.」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet you're planning to go do a tasting at the cake shop.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you're going anyway, let's go together. The next stop is a sweet shop, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you for the meal.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「People who like Western sweets are truly pitiful, aren't they.」
If I remember right, this is the president of the Wagashi Club--Ria-senpai's friend, Misasagi-senpai.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the Wagashi Club is lending a hand at Prier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I'm starting to get full, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying? This is a proper duty too, so we have to do a thorough tasting.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a gives it her stamp of approval too.」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're full, you don't have to force yourself.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a will eat it instead. Right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not what I meant...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. You just can't help wanting to eat them, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not true! You're making me sound like a glutton.\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nobody went so far as to call you a glutton, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, unfortunately, that duty belongs to the President and me! And so--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here are Prier's special Japanese sweets. Eat up plenty, alright?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the food~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmmm~ So sweet and delicious~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Nom, nom... It's good... but I'm stuffed...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it can't be helped. I'll eat it for you, chomp♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, have some tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, thank you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the meal!\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a hearty appetite. Don't you think, Rii-a?」

name: Ria
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thanks to that, there's none left for Rii-a to sample. Sorry about that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, President. Let's head to the next one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wai... my tea...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Come back soon, y'hear?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, thank you for the meal. Just a little more to go, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-We're still eating...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Giving up on a mission halfway through is completely out of the question.」

name: Synn
message: 「S... Somebody take my place...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello~ We've come for a tasting.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Welco~me.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, that means--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep! I'm helping out at the cake shop~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... Nanakaa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Takahashi-san. We aren't finished talking over here yet, are we?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Madam Vice President. What are you doing here?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「He's being interrogated~」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't make it sound so terrible. It's a meeting, a meeting.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here for a tasting, right~? Wait just a sec~」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, hey! Hmph, honestly!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Munch, munch... How exciting~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, you're eating something again!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the cream anmitsu we received as a souvenir from the sweets shop earlier.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「More sweets?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is always a separate stomach for sweet and delicious things.」

name: Synn
message: 「A girl's body is way too mysterious... I can't take any more...」

name: Misa
message: 「You just overate without thinking ahead anyway, didn't you? You really have zero sense of planning.」

name: Synn
message: 「No... Lolotte has been eating way more than me everywhere we go.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting--here's an impromptu cake buffet~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Please enjoy these many masterpieces our pastry chef poured their heart into--」
Plates of cake are brought out one after another. Each individual piece is bite-sized and dainty, yet countless more assassins lie in wait behind Sacchin.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can't... eat all of this... Especially heavy stuff like chocolate...」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't this way too much, even for you? You'll get fat if you eat that much.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll get a stomachache before that happens...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just leave the leftovers to us in the Sweets Club.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka! You're a lifesaver...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I came running the second I heard about new chocolate creations.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. Please don't underestimate me. This much is nothing at all. Right, Mr. President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let the party begin!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the meal!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't even tell what anything tastes like anymore...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-My cakes... *slump*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This much is a total piece of cake and pickled veggies, you know.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Amazing, isn't it? Where does it all go in that tiny body of hers--」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll have to get her to tell me her secret to not gaining weight later...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Mr. President. Let's move on to the next round!」
Lolotte's stomach is a bottomless pit...
